questions.nlq: I would like to retrieve the display names of all participants who have authored answers (posts with PostTypeId = 2) that received a score greater than 15, and also show the total number of their comments that were scored above 60, ordering the result by the summed answer scores in descending order.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT u.DisplayName,
       COALESCE(c.high_comment_cnt, 0) AS high_score_comment_count
FROM users u
JOIN (
    SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id,
           SUM(Score) AS total_answer_score
    FROM posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 2
      AND Score > 15
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
) a ON u.Id = a.user_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT UserId,
           COUNT(*) AS high_comment_cnt
    FROM comments
    WHERE Score > 60
    GROUP BY UserId
) c ON u.Id = c.UserId
ORDER BY a.total_answer_score DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term display name refers to the name that appears on a post as the owner’s display name column in the Posts table, which can differ from the user’s profile name and may be null for community‑owned posts.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT p.OwnerDisplayName AS display_name,
       COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c
       ON c.UserId = p.OwnerUserId
      AND c.Score > 60
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 2
  AND p.Score > 15
GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId, p.OwnerDisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(p.Score) DESC;

WITH edits AS (
    SELECT PostId AS post_id, CreationDate AS edit_date
    FROM postHistory
    WHERE PostHistoryTypeId IN (4,5,6)
),
linked_posts AS (
    SELECT pl.PostId AS src, pl.RelatedPostId AS linked
    FROM postLinks pl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pl.RelatedPostId AS src, pl.PostId AS linked
    FROM postLinks pl
),
comment_stats AS (
    SELECT lp.src AS post_id,
           COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count,
           AVG(c.Score) AS avg_comment_score
    FROM linked_posts lp
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = lp.src OR c.PostId = lp.linked
    GROUP BY lp.src
),
tag_ranks AS (
    SELECT p.Id AS post_id,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.Tags ORDER BY p.Score DESC) AS score_dense_rank
    FROM posts p
)
SELECT
    u.DisplayName AS display_name,
    cs.comment_count,
    cs.avg_comment_score,
    tr.score_dense_rank,
    (SELECT SUM(c2.Score)
     FROM comments c2
     WHERE (c2.PostId = e.post_id
            OR c2.PostId IN (SELECT linked FROM linked_posts WHERE src = e.post_id)
            OR c2.PostId IN (SELECT src FROM linked_posts WHERE linked = e.post_id))
       AND c2.CreationDate <= e.edit_date) AS running_total_comment_score
FROM edits e
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = e.post_id
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
JOIN comment_stats cs ON cs.post_id = p.Id
JOIN tag_ranks tr ON tr.post_id = p.Id
ORDER BY p.Id, e.edit_date;

    SELECT
        ep.post_id,

        AVG(c.Score) AS avg_comment_score
    FROM editable_posts ep
    JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = ep.post_id

),

    SELECT
        p.Id AS post_id,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.Score) + 1
         FROM posts p2

               WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'

    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.Id IN (SELECT post_id FROM editable_posts)

FROM posts p
JOIN editable_posts ep ON p.Id = ep.post_id
JOIN comment_stats cs ON p.Id = cs.post_id

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(p.OwnerDisplayName, u.DisplayName) AS display_name,
       AVG(p.Score) AS avg_score
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 5000
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<bayesian>%'
GROUP BY display_name;

LEFT JOIN posts a ON a."ParentId" = q."Id" AND a."PostTypeId" = 2
WHERE q."PostTypeId" = 1
  AND q."ViewCount" > 5000
  AND q."Tags" LIKE '%<bayesian>%'
GROUP BY q."Id", q."LastEditorDisplayName";
